design.title: Design the purchase flow on top of the store prototype
design.description:
The store prototype works. Someone should now be able to find a Quiver, see who will
build it, and pay for it without needing to understand the DAO first. Design that
journey properly, on top of what is already running.

growth.title: Walk into Arrow from every direction and report where the path loses people
growth.description:
Walk into Arrow the way a stranger would, from all four directions, and tell us where
the path works and where it loses people.

operations.title: AIP-009 Accelerator: call meeting and publish decision ledger
operations.description:
An accelerator bounty. AIP-009's commerce side is moving; the bonding side has not been
picked up. Get the people who can settle it into one room and write down what they
decide.

operations.title: Put live Discord events on the community calls page
operations.description:
The website cannot tell you what is happening this week. Wire the calls page to Discord's
events so it shows every session across the projects, and write the page so a newcomer
knows they can just turn up.
